formal_evidence.review_scope: Read complete supplement and Retrieval.lean; checked hash equality and recorded report status/build exit codes. Did not rerun Lean independently in this council turn.

resolved_draft_findings: Explicit nullary target rejects ambiguous parameter quantification. F AND NOT P and identical generated scopes preserve facts and distinguish N from solver scope.
Complete independently evaluated anonymous instances replace display objects; joint atom bijection preserves typed memberships and integer meanings, with exact-byte confirmation and fail-closed caps.
Environment erases only target body and unrelated source command; target-dependent facts/functions retain body dependency token, preventing false cross-context overlap.
3072 dimensions derive from four genuine pinned pretrained 768 blocks and explicit learned diagonal adapters; no hash/padding fallback, no mixed model versions.
Atomic pair/outbox, pre/post authorization checks, independent revocation journal and checkpoint lineage invalidation cover stale/revoked vectors and restore behavior.
Trusted FULL record-ID API prevents client-submitted vectors or pool labels gaining evidence authority.
Family grouping, duplicate union, train-only adapter fitting, frozen validation weights and held-out promotion rule distinguish synthetic structural retrieval from semantic correctness.

implementation_acceptance_notes.note: FULL records require exact N isomorphism-distinct validated members per polarity. This excludes many valid tautologies/contradictions/small instance spaces; report coverage and PARTIAL reasons without weakening admission.

Regression tests must include target-dependent facts, contradictory facts, ignored hostile original command scopes, consistent renaming across multiple relations, empty fields, integer atoms, isomorphism cap, and SAT followed by enumeration timeout.

Revocation must block all vectors using affected adapter checkpoints, including otherwise active records. Test revoke during outbox publish and restore from before revocation; durable journal failure leaves service quarantined.

Serialize only allowed anonymous structures into encoder inputs. Keep provenance, source hash, dataset family, rights metadata, paths and display names out of all four components, including context and proof metadata.

Test actual installed PostgreSQL/pgvector and LangGraph, downloaded model integrity and tokenizer/chunk recipe; earlier inspection found infrastructure and pretrained caches unavailable, so these remain implementation work.

Macro-family held-out MRR promotion and minimum family/source coverage are empirical gates. If quality or cohort size fails, keep quality gate open and retain eligible baseline rather than tune after test.

formal_limits: The proofs establish supplied abstract identities/flags and fixed integer scoring policy, not faithful Java/SQL identities, witness canonicalization, floats, tuned weights, evaluator correctness or learned quality.
ready_three_witness is a nonvacuous abstract policy example, not evidence that any concrete Alloy dataset supplies three witnesses per polarity.
Checked egraph representative equality is scoped; finite samples, cosine similarity, pool overlap and Luna judgment never confer semantic equivalence or proof badges.
gate_status: Design approved for exact frozen revision. G4/G5 implementation and empirical acceptance remain open; no original gate or commercial clearance is certified here.
